verses.1: And it happened during the time when the year began again, when the kings went out. Joab led the army of Israel. He conquered the land of the people of Israel. David ruled in Jerusalem. Then Joab destroyed Rabbah.
verses.2: David took the crown of kings from his head. It was weighed as if it were made of gold. Inside it, there was a precious stone. The crown rested on David’s head, and the wealth of the city increased greatly.
verses.3: And he brought out the people who lived there and settled them in the wilderness, in the land of iron. And David did the same for all the cities of his people. Then David returned, and all the people settled in Jerusalem.
verses.4: And after that, he stood in battle against the Philistines. Then his armor bearer struck me with his sword from among the doctors of healing. They were defeated.
verses.5: And there was still war with the Philistines. Then Elnan, son of Ya’ir, fought against me. My brother Galyat also fought alongside him. And the tree of Hanitho became like a torch in their hands.
verses.6: There was still war in Gath. There was a man from there, and the number of his teeth was sixty-six. And he also died.
verses.7: And He destroyed Israel. Yehonatan, son of Shemaiah, was the one who destroyed them.
verses.8: They were sent to be healed in Gath, but they fell into the hands of David and his servants.
